svg.title: Ontario 2026 property tax credits and grants homeowners should check
svg.desc: 2026 Ontario Energy and Property Tax Credit maximums are $1,307 for non-seniors and $1,488 for seniors. The Ontario Senior Homeowners Property Tax Grant maximum is $500. A labelled municipal senior rebate example is Brampton $590. None of these are automatic without a filing.
svg.text: Ontario relief is a checklist, not a smaller mill rate
CRA 2026 OEPTC and OSHPTG Q&As (used 20 Sep 2026). ontario.ca Senior Homeowners- Property Tax Grant page updated 2 Jan 2026.
OEPTC: $290 energy + $1,017 property (non-senior) or $1,198 property (senior). Paid via Ontario Trillium Benefit unless an exception applies.
OSHPTG is the lesser of $500 and 2025 property tax paid. File ON-BEN. City programs (Toronto deadline 2 Nov 2026) are a separate form.
Maximums are not your payment. Income tests apply. Land transfer tax refunds are for buyers, not the annual bill. Not tax advice.
